components.name: Heading Freshness and Refresh
components.description: Green Connected represents fresh, verified Ollama, Tailscale, forwarding, host evidence, and model readiness. An idle GPU is healthy. Other combined results use Connection issue, Needs attention, Check needed, or Disconnected.
components.html: Connected-Just now

narrative.overview: Readiness, connection age, and an icon-only Settings action lead the centered single-column dashboard. App launch marks and colored status dots identify each check. Slender hourly bars close the GPU usage section. The product identity remains in the native title bar and icon.
keyCharacteristics: A light interface centered horizontally and vertically when space allows.
Readiness and connection freshness with icon-only Settings on the right.
Four continuous status rows with colored dots and visible recovery guidance.
App launch marks, real installed models, and a compact GPU usage section.
The existing R2-D2 artwork in the page identity and native app icon.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Use green for confirmed positive readiness, amber for attention or unverified checks, and rust for an error. Idle and stale readings use the muted neutral. Pair each state dot with a clear word.

rules.name: The Binary Hour Rule
rules.body: An hourly pill has two data states, Active or Idle. A filled pill represents qualifying observed GPU activity while an Ollama model was in GPU memory. Empty and unmonitored hours display Idle.

rules.name: The Single Typeface Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope throughout the interface. Distinguish readings, controls, and explanations through size and weight, with tabular figures for times and model sizes.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate persistent surfaces with spacing, a fine border, or a tonal fill. Reserve the small soft shadow for the temporary hour tooltip.

rules.name: The Whole Path Rule
rules.body: Reserve green Connected for fresh, verified connection and readiness evidence. Ollama, Tailscale, forwarding, host details, and the model library must be healthy; the GPU may be healthy or idle. Other results use their combined warning, error, or unverified state.

dos: Do use the implemented palette and self-hosted Manrope.
Do keep connection state, age, and refresh directly under the readiness heading.
Do pair status dots with words and name the Settings icon for assistive technology.
Do keep failure guidance and recovery actions visible.
Do show real model names and preserve the bundled app and Qwen marks.
Do preserve hour inspection, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the active R2-D2 artwork in the native icon.
Do use generic examples and keep personal connection details out of public artifacts.
donts: Don't add a repeated product label or mascot to the main viewport.
Don't give ordinary status rows empty disclosures or hide recovery guidance behind a click.
Don't turn the readiness list into a grid of separate cards.
Don't describe the binary history as request counts or exact inference attribution.
Don't imply an app link opens a window on a remote computer.
Don't use color alone to communicate a reading.
Don't add shadows to persistent containers, glass, textures, or decorative data imagery.
Don't use em dashes in product copy or public documentation.
